digest: Krista and her partner Nick donated time and materials to build a new stage in the garden for the Autumn Gather, and tickets are still available. Organizers would love to borrow 2 more pizza peels for this evening if anyone has them to lend. Lunch menus, picture day dates, and more are all in one place on the Harmony dashboard.
